name: team-shopify
description: Add-on team for Shopify store repos (e.g. smartwatchbanden): the subagents Liam, Sandra, and Steven, the domain skill start-task (new branch + preview theme), and an operational floor -- a PreToolUse guard that refuses a theme publish, a theme delete, or an unauthorised push to the live theme, whatever shell wraps the command, plus adopt-shopify-floor to place that floor in a repo (the guard's seam, a starter theme-check config, and the CI workflow over it). Deliberately NOT repo-neutral — only a Shopify repo enables this team. Teams stack: this one adds to 'team-alpha', and a commercial Shopify repo typically enables 'team-ecomm' alongside it. The governance layer (CLAUDE.md + the repo lenses) stays separate.
